slides.title: Find the *real range*
slides.body: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes pay for hundreds of jobs by state and metro area, from the 10th to the 90th percentile. CareerOneStop shows it free. Search your job title and your city.

slides.title: Read *5 job ads*
slides.body: In many states, including California, Colorado, New York and Washington, job ads must show the pay range. Save 5 ads for your exact role. That is what the market pays right now.

slides.title: You can *talk pay*
slides.body: Under federal labor law, most private sector workers have the right to discuss pay with coworkers, union or not. Rules that ban it are generally unlawful. Ask someone you trust.

slides.title: Let *Claude* build the case
slides.body: Paste your range, the ads and a messy list of your wins, then ask: Turn this into a one page raise case with my number, 3 results with proof, and the first sentence I should say.

slides.title: Plan for *not now*
slides.body: Ask for a meeting just for this. Have Claude play your manager and push back. If the answer is not now, ask what you need to do and by when, then confirm it by email the same day.

cta.gift: Here is your free raise guide: where to find real pay data, the Claude prompts to build your case, and what to say when they push back.
cta.small: Free, right in your DMs. General info, *not legal advice.*
